verdict.rationale: Letta ships an official CLI ('Letta Code') with extensive first-party documentation covering interactive slash commands, headless/non-interactive mode for CI/CD, agent switching, memory management, and local/cloud modes, corroborated by a dedicated CLI docs page and probe confirmation. missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party review of the CLI itself (evidence is entirely vendor docs plus a probe, no community usage report specifically of the CLI).
